**What would you like the provider to do?**

_A clear and concise description of the enhancement. If it concerns an existing
resource or data source, please name it (e.g. `mittwald_app`)._

**Why do you need this?**

_Which use case is currently not covered, or which workaround do you have to use today?_

**Proposed configuration**

_If applicable, sketch how you would like to use this in a Terraform configuration.
This does not have to be final — it just helps us understand what you have in mind._

```terraform
resource "mittwald_..." "example" {
  # ...
}
```

**Related mStudio features or API endpoints**

_If the functionality already exists in the [mStudio](https://studio.mittwald.de) or in the
[mittwald API](https://developer.mittwald.de/docs/v2/api/intro/), please link to it._

**Additional context**

_Any other context, alternatives you have considered, or links to related issues._
